name: cavemio-log-stream
title: Log stream
description: A live tail you can actually read: scroll up and it lets go while a "↓ 128 new" pill counts what arrives, with pause, level counts, search and lines that open into their fields.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The scrolling area is focusable and scrolls with the keyboard. Lines are a list; lines with data are buttons with aria-expanded. The list is not a live region, so a busy tail never floods a screen reader; pausing and resuming are announced instead.
- "/" focuses search while focus is inside the stream; Escape clears it.
- Rows use content-visibility, so a thousand lines lay out only what's on screen, and each row is memoised on its own line: a new batch renders only the new rows.
- Levels are told by word as well as colour: "err" and "warn" in red and amber, with a 2px tick at the line's edge.
- Reduced motion drops the fades, the pill's rise, the ping and the smooth scroll; lines still arrive and the counts still change.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: subscribe
props.description: – · Starts the tail. Call push with one line or many, as often as you like; return a function that stops it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: – · Lines to start with, oldest first: { id, at, level, message, source?, data? }.

props.name: loadEarlier
props.description: – · Loads lines older than the first one, oldest first. Return an empty list when there are no more.

props.name: max
props.description: 1000 · Lines kept while the view is pinned to the bottom. While you're reading further up nothing is dropped.

props.name: title
props.description: "Logs" · Names the list and the search field for screen readers.

features.title: Pinned until you scroll up
features.description: New lines are drawn once per frame however fast they arrive, and only your own scroll lets go of the bottom.

features.title: It counts what you missed
features.description: A “↓ 128 new” pill rises with its count rolling, and one tap takes you back down.

features.title: Pause without losing lines
features.description: Live becomes Paused and holds lines back (“Paused · 42 waiting”). Live plays them in again.

features.title: Levels and search
features.description: Level chips count lines as they arrive, search marks every match, and / focuses it.

features.title: Lines open into their fields
features.description: A line with data opens under itself into its fields, with a Copy button.

features.title: Older lines on demand
features.description: Reaching the top loads earlier lines above without moving the line you are reading.

states.title: tail
states.description: Pushed lines are collected and rendered once per animation frame. Up to 12 new lines fade in from a 2px blur (260ms); bigger bursts simply appear. Each commit ends on the newest line while the view is pinned.

states.title: reading
states.description: A scroll you make (wheel, touch, keys or the scrollbar) lets go; content changing size never does. New lines keep arriving and the pill rises 10px into place (420ms) with its count rolling. Tapping it scrolls down smoothly and pins the view again; so does scrolling back to the bottom.

states.title: paused
states.description: The green pinging dot turns grey and Live morphs to Paused; lines are held, and "· 42 waiting" opens beside it, rolling. Live plays them in as one batch.

states.title: filter
states.description: Level chips count every line in memory (the numbers roll) and hide their level when switched off. Search marks every match in the message and keeps only lines that match the message or source.

states.title: open
states.description: A line with data is a button; it opens by height in 320ms into a thin line box of its fields (numbers in the primary colour, strings quoted) with a Copy that morphs to Copied.

states.title: earlier
states.description: With loadEarlier, reaching the top loads older lines above; the scroll position is corrected in the same frame, so the line you were reading doesn't move. An empty answer says "Start of the log".
